== Summary ==
Location-layout diagram from Decipher’s ''Star Wars Customizable Card Game Rulebook'', Version 2.0 (November 1998).

== Source ==
Decipher, ''Rulebook 2.0'', PDF page 5, printed page 5–13: diagram under '''Deploying locations'''. Open the [[Media:Decipher_Rulebook_2.0.pdf|full source PDF]] or the [[Star Wars Customizable Card Game RULEBOOK 2.0|wiki reading copy]]. Original publisher document: [http://www.decipher.com/starwars/rules/pdf/serules.pdf serules.pdf].

This is an existing raster reproduction of the diagram, visually checked against the full document. The layout shows interior sites, a docking bay, exterior sites and the system location.
